description.en:
Generates two-way AutoDrive ring routes around fields, so you do not have to drive every headland by hand.
Console commands: adfl [offset] [spacing] [mode] ring around the field you are standing in adflAll [offset] [spacing] [mode] ring around every field on the map adflRefresh [offset] [spacing] [mode] rebuild the ring for the current field adflRemove remove the ring for the current field adflRemoveAll remove every ring this mod created adflInfo report what is under you and what is generated
mode is "map" (surveyed field boundary, instant) or "scan" (traces the ground you have actually ploughed, slower, picks up extensions and merged fields).
Requires FS25_AutoDrive.
